session.createNewSessionBody: There's unsent text in the prompt box. Starting a new session will discard it.
session.deleteSessionBody: This will permanently delete the chat and its history.

input.placeholderIdle: Type a prompt and hit Enter… (paste or attach images)
input.compactingNotice: Compacting context, your input is temporarily disabled
input.attachLimitWarn_one: {{count}} file rejected: not an image, larger than 5MB, or would exceed {{limit}}-image limit.
input.attachLimitWarn_other: {{count}} files rejected: not an image, larger than 5MB, or would exceed {{limit}}-image limit.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Let's set up the basics so you can start chatting with your codebase.
onboarding.workspaceBody: This is the directory Taco will use for sessions, tools, and files.
onboarding.workspaceInvalid: Please choose a valid directory path.
onboarding.providerBody: Add an API key for at least one provider. You can add more later in Settings.
onboarding.providerRequired: Configure at least one provider to continue.
onboarding.modelBody: This model will be used for new sessions.

activity.selectAgentPrompt: Select an agent to view its prompt.
activity.skillsEmptyHint: Add a SKILL.md file in ~/.taco/skills/ or <cwd>/.taco/skills/ (also scans ~/.pi/skills/, <cwd>/.pi/skills/).

settings.appearanceDesc: Choose a light or dark theme, or follow your operating system.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language for the assistant's replies.
settings.permissionsDesc: Controls when shell commands need approval. Destructive and privilege-changing commands always require a prompt or are blocked.
settings.permissionsNoRules: No global command approvals saved yet.
settings.permissionsRuleErrorShellWrapper: Shell wrapper "{{shell}}" is not allowed in rules
settings.permissionsPersistentDisabled: Destructive or external commands always require approval.
settings.compactionDesc: When the conversation context reaches the configured share of the model's window, older messages are folded into a structured summary. Pinned constraints and instructions survive compaction verbatim.
settings.compactionEnabledDesc: Compress context automatically once the threshold is reached.
settings.compactionThresholdHint: Lower = compress more aggressively. Keep under 95% so a single response still has room.
settings.compactionManualHint: Use the message panel's /compact command (or the top-bar indicator) to compress on demand.
settings.contextDesc: TACO reads CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / DESIGN.md from the workspace and injects them as <instructions> on every LLM call.
settings.contextEnabledDesc: When disabled, the model sees no project-level rule files.
settings.contextInheritDesc: The parent workspace's <instructions> blocks are also appended to each subagent's rebuilt system prompt.
settings.debugModeDesc: Dump every LLM request to stderr (requires restart).
settings.debugModeToggleDesc: Turn on the in-memory LLM Dump panel and log each request to stderr.
settings.llmDumpToFileDesc: Also append LLM dump lines to $TACO_HOME/logs/llm-dump.log. Requires debug mode.
settings.debugModeToast: ✅ Sidecar restarted — debug mode is now in effect
settings.defaultModelDesc: Default applied to new sessions. Changes take effect on the next prompt and for sessions created after the sidecar picks up the new config.
settings.providerFirst: Add an API key for a provider above to choose a model.
settings.providersDesc: Add an API key to enable a provider. Keys are stored locally and sent only to that provider.
settings.customProviderIdClash: This id already exists. Pick a different one.
settings.customProviderFetchEmpty: That endpoint returned no model ids; please type them manually
settings.customProviderFetchUnsupported: This protocol has no model discovery
settings.defaultThinkingDesc: Applied to new sessions unless overridden at creation time. Changing this does not affect currently-running sessions.
settings.restartHint: ⚠ Debug mode takes effect after the sidecar restarts. Dump entries may contain full prompts — treat as sensitive.
settings.mcpServersDesc: Configure MCP servers to expose tools to the assistant. MCP tools are not gated by the command-permission broker — only add servers you trust.
settings.mcpServersRefreshHint: Refresh connectivity for enabled servers. Hold Shift to also probe disabled servers.
settings.mcpServersRestartHint: Changes take effect after the sidecar restarts. Use the button on the right to apply now.
settings.mcpServersApplyAndRestartHint: Save changes and restart the sidecar process. Affects every open workspace — any in-flight turn in any workspace will be aborted.
settings.mcpServersRestarted: Sidecar restarted — MCP tools are now live.
settings.mcpServerIdClash: This id already exists. Pick a different one.
settings.mcpServerArgsHint: Each line becomes one argument. Quoting is not parsed — values with spaces or '=' must be edited in taco.json directly.
settings.mcpServerEnvHint: Leave blank to inherit the sidecar's environment. Split on the first '='; values with '=' inside must be edited in taco.json directly.
settings.mcpServerUrlInvalid: Must be a valid http(s) URL.
settings.mcpServerHeaders: HTTP headers (one per line, Header: value)
settings.mcpServerHeadersHint: Optional. Used for Authorization headers, etc. Split on the first ':'; quoting is not parsed.
settings.mcpServerTimeoutHint: Per-operation timeout for connect, listTools, and callTool. Default 15000.
settings.mcpServerAlwaysLoaded: Always-loaded tools (MCP-side raw names, one per line)
settings.mcpServerAlwaysLoadedHint: These tools are resident from session start. All others are loaded on demand.
settings.mcpServerStatusSkippedHint: Server is disabled. Refresh with the button above (force probe) to check connectivity, or re-enable and restart the sidecar.

updates.title: Updates
updates.desc: Check for desktop updates. New versions ship fixes and features; the app restarts after install.

tools.selectToView: Select a tool to view details
tools.skillsSelectToView: Select a skill to view details

checkpoints.title: Restore points
checkpoints.disabled: Checkpoints are unavailable in this workspace.
checkpoints.emptyHint: Checkpoints are created automatically when the agent edits files. Restore here to roll a turn's changes back.
checkpoints.confirmMessage: Roll back {{count}} file(s) from "{{label}}". A pre-restore snapshot is taken first, so this can be undone.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Toggle an extension, then restart the sidecar to apply.
plugins.configHint: Add or remove extension names in `~/.taco/taco.json` under `extensions` and `disabledExtensions`, then restart.
plugins.emptyDisabled: No extensions disabled. Remove a name from `disabledExtensions` in ~/.taco/taco.json and restart to enable.
plugins.disabledHint: In taco.json's `disabledExtensions`. Click Enable to remove it, then restart.
plugins.restartBanner: Changes require a sidecar restart to take effect.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Bind an IM account so you can talk to the agent from your phone.
channels.configHint: Declare channel instances in `~/.taco/taco.json` under `channels`, then restart. Credentials are stored separately in `~/.taco/channels/`.
channels.pendingRestart: Channel instance added. Restart the sidecar to make it bindable.
channels.scanHint: Scan this code with WeChat to authorize the bot.
channels.scannedHint: Scanned. Confirm on your phone to continue.
channels.verifyCodeHint: Enter the pairing code shown in WeChat on your phone.
channels.verifyCodeRetry: That code was rejected. Enter the pairing code again.
channels.expiredHint: The code expired. Close this dialog and bind again.
channels.emptyConversations: No IM conversations yet. Send a message to your bound channel to start one.
channels.boundHint: Channel bound — you can close this dialog.
channels.imBanner: Live reply — sending here delivers directly to {{peer}} on WeChat.

imPolicy.desc: Grant tools and command permissions. Fields left as "inherit" fall back to the level below (chat → channel → built-in default).
imPolicy.ruleErrorShellWrapper: Shell wrapper "{{shell}}" is not allowed in rules
imPolicy.invalidCwd: Working directory must be an absolute path.
imPolicy.saveConfirmInterrupt: Saving this policy will immediately apply it and may interrupt in-progress conversations. Continue?

memory.title: Memory
memory.noTopics: No topics for this project yet.
memory.deleteTopicBody: This will permanently remove this memory entry.
memory.emptyState: No memory yet. Entries are extracted automatically after each conversation.
memory.disabledHint: Enable memoryEnabled (default true) in ~/.taco/taco.json and restart sidecar.
memory.conflictBody: New entries were extracted while you were editing. Choose how to resolve.

plan.modeTooltip: Plan mode: only the plan document and shell inspection (read-only commands) are writable. Tools contributed by extensions are not gated — review their output before relying on it.
